gloss: the actual exam; the main examination

definitions.gloss: the actual exam; the main examination; the real test
definitions.explanation: The official examination itself, as opposed to a practice test, a mock exam, or a makeup sitting. The {本|ほん} marks it as the genuine occasion on which the result counts.

examples.japanese: {本試験|ほんしけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The actual exam is next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{模擬|もぎ}{試験|しけん}→模擬試験：18219_mogishiken⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{本試験|ほんしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The actual exam was harder than the mock exam.

examples.japanese: {本試験|ほんしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けられなかった→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{追試|ついし}→追試：09971_tsuishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: Students who could not sit the actual exam are to take a makeup test.

notes:
{本|ほん} (main, actual, this very) + ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (examination). The same {本|ほん} appears in ⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧ (the real performance) and {本大会|ほんたいかい} (the main tournament).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本試験|ほんしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to sit the actual exam
- {本試験|ほんしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧: in preparation for the actual exam
- {本試験|ほんしけん}⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧: the day of the exam

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追試|ついし}→追試：09971_tsuishi⟧: makeup exam — taken later by those who missed or failed the main one
- ⟦{模擬試験|もぎしけん}→模擬試験：18219_mogishiken⟧: mock exam — practice under exam conditions, results do not count
- ⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧: the real thing — broader, used of performances and live broadcasts as well as tests
